descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
We are looking for an experienced Senior Angular Developer with strong expertise in frontend development and a good command of the German language. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining modern, scalable web applications, working closely with cross-functional teams in an international environment.
Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain complex web applications using Angular and TypeScript.
Build reusable, scalable, and high-performance frontend components.
Collaborate with backend developers, UX/UI designers, and business stakeholders.
Translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and adherence to best practices.
Optimize application performance, usability, and responsiveness.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and technical discussions.
Communicate with German-speaking stakeholders and team members.
 Requirements 
5+ years of professional experience in frontend development.
Strong experience with Angular and TypeScript.
Good knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Experience with RxJS and Angular Material.
Solid understanding of REST APIs and frontend-backend integration.
Experience with Git and modern development workflows.
Knowledge of unit testing frameworks such as Jasmine, Karma, or Jest.
Understanding of responsive design and web application performance optimization.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
 German language skills at B2 level or higher. 
Good command of English.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with NgRx or other state management solutions.
Knowledge of Node.js.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
Familiarity with microservices architectures.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
 Work Arrangement & Contract Type 
Work arrangement: Remote / Hybrid (depending on project requirements).
Contract type: Employment contract (CIM) or B2B collaboration (SRL/PFA).
